scripts.dev: concurrently -n sync,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/sync" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/sync && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/sync && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
